# Apex Wallet
Apex Wallet public legal, compliance, and login pages.

Canonical: https://apexwallet.app

/login - Public login and wallet access page
/coming-soon - Public placeholder page for unreleased features
/legal/terms - Terms of Service (FICA, FSCA, SARB, POCA compliant)
/legal/privacy - Privacy Policy (POPIA No. 4 of 2013 compliant)
/legal/risk-disclosure - Risk Disclosure Statement (FSCA guidelines)
/legal/aml-policy - AML, FICA and Compliance Policy (FATF Travel Rule, CARF, sanctions screening)
